name: tags-input

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows five tags plus the clear Add a tag field, the fullest state of the list.

tagline: Blue tag pills collect inside a box as you type and press Enter.
summary: An input that keeps chosen skills as removable blue pills. You type in the field and press Enter or comma to add one; clicking a pill loads it back into the field to edit.
appearance: A bordered rounded box on a dark page holds a row of small blue pills with white text and a white cross on each. Below them, inside the same box, sits a dark text field reading Add a tag...; a muted Skills label and hint sit outside.
behaviour: Typing and pressing Enter or comma adds the text as a new pill and clears the field, unless the tag already exists. Clicking a pill swaps it for an editable field, and blurring or pressing Enter saves the change; each cross removes its pill.
demo_content: Skills typed as React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Motion and Accessibility, with a press Enter hint.
search_phrases: add chips with enter or comma
tag entry field with blue chips
click a tag to edit it
use_when: People need to enter several short labels, such as skills or keywords, in one field.
avoid_when: Duplicate tags are silently ignored and there is no autocomplete, so long lists get tedious.
customise: Pass tags and setTags to control the list, and editTag to allow inline editing. Colours and pill shapes come from classes in the source.
weight_why: A few text pills and two inputs with no animation loop.

a11y.note: Tags are clickable divs rather than buttons, so keyboard users cannot start editing, and the crosses lack names.

issues: Remove buttons are bare × marks with no accessible name.
Pills are clickable divs, so a keyboard user cannot start editing a tag.
polish_why: Clean pill entry with clear hover and focus; the bright blue and bare crosses look plain.
title: Tags Input
